_comment: chirp ground (NFM) daemon defaults. Phase 4a defaults + Phase 4b 'sdr' block. Separate UDP port + state path + hit log + icecast fallback from airband so the two daemons can coexist. See chirp/config/README.md.

sdr._comment: SDR source defaults for ground. Revision 4.0 (arrangement C, M1, macOS, 2026-07-08): ground NFM runs on its dedicated RTL-SDR (serial 61108285) — the proven 2026-06-18 fix, UNCHANGED. (Revision 3.0 briefly moved ground onto an RSP tuner; C reverts that — the RSP is digital-only now, so ground stays on the RTL where it has always been most reliable.) gr-osmosdr addresses the RTL by its native 'rtl=<serial>' source type, not soapy=driver=rtlsdr. No bandwidth_hz needed for RTL (0 = driver default). center_freq_hz set to 138.05 MHz (177th Fighter Wing — the busiest ground channel by far in rtl-airband's stats).
